Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the century as the 18th century in its initial analysis. Tecumseh was born in 1768 (late 18th century) but formed the large multi-tribal confederacy and became its primary leader in the early 1810s (specifically after meeting Tenskwatawa around 1808 and leading up to the Battle of Tippecanoe in 1811). The 1810s fall within the 19th century, not the 18th. This fundamental error in historical timeline calculation led to the wrong final answer.
